entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: A 24-bit counter used for NAS security operations, consisting of an 8-bit NAS sequence number and 16-bit NAS overflow counter. Maintained separately for uplink and downlink directions by both UE and MME.

entities.name: NAS sequence number
entities.description: The 8 least significant bits of NAS COUNT that are exchanged in NAS signaling messages.

entities.name: NAS overflow counter
entities.description: The 16 most significant bits of NAS COUNT that increment when the NAS sequence number wraps around.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that maintains uplink and downlink NAS COUNT counters.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that maintains uplink and downlink NAS COUNT counters.

entities.name: NAS token
entities.description: Security token used during inter-system change procedures for NAS COUNT synchronization.

entities.name: Mapped EPS security context
entities.description: Security context derived during inter-system handovers where NAS COUNT counters may be reset or synchronized.

entities.name: NAS security transparent container
entities.description: Container used during handover procedures that carries NAS COUNT information.

relations.description: NAS COUNT consists of NAS sequence number as its 8 least significant bits.
NAS COUNT consists of NAS overflow counter as its 16 most significant bits.
UE independently maintains uplink and downlink NAS COUNT counters.
MME independently maintains uplink and downlink NAS COUNT counters.
NAS token triggers NAS COUNT updates during inter-system change procedures.
Mapped EPS security context derivation affects NAS COUNT values, including reset to zero or synchronization.
NAS security transparent container carries NAS COUNT information during handover procedures.
